baseline.method: Original 250-step I-CLASS phase kernel; independently corrected S18/spatial output, sigma=0.01

reference_type: validated standard method, not physical truth
alignment: integer circular translation maximizing image cross-correlation; no amplitude fitting
consistency_definition: L2 relative image/MTF error using public observations and submitted OTF correction; covariance coherent-diagonal energy divided by squared total camera power
tolerance_note: Nonzero float32 numerical tolerances; covariance boundary is frozen from the reproduced upstream kernel before final scoring.
